subject: Observability renewal: marketplace bundling & retention options
messages:
From: Anna Park <anna@datadog.com>
To: sergio_alvarez
Cc: lauren_bishop
Date: 2026-06-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft renewal + retention add-on pricing

Sergio / Lauren,

Thanks for the time last week. Attached is the draft renewal quote for Datadog (standard + 90-day retention add-on) and a short note about marketplace bundling options with Grafana Cloud. High level:

- 12-month term, current seat-based discount applied
- Retention add-on: 90 days indexed logs, pricing shown per ingested GB
- Marketplace bundling: we can combine through the AWS/GCP marketplace for a single invoice; Grafana needs a separate addendum but we can cover licensing coordination

I've attached the PDF quote (Datadog_renewal_quote_Jun2026.pdf). Please let me know if you want a version that routes through marketplace or direct contract — routing affects invoicing and org-level discounts.

Best,

Anna Park
Account Executive, Datadog
anna@datadog.com

Attachment: Datadog_renewal_quote_Jun2026.pdf

From: sergio_alvarez
To: lauren_bishop, markus_klein, neha_kapoor
Cc: Anna Park <anna@datadog.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft renewal + retention add-on pricing

Thanks Anna — looping in Lauren (finance) + Markus (infra) and Neha (security) to validate the retention profile and marketplace route.

Quick context for internal reviewers:
- AcmeOps' Datadog contract renews end of July (current term expires 2026-07-31)
- They ingest ~1.2TB/day; retention add-on materially drives cost
- Customer prefers single-bill experience via cloud marketplace to centralize procurement (they use AWS Marketplace)

Two asks for internal folks:
1) Markus — can you confirm whether 90-day indexed logs meets our internal observability needs for support escalations? Any risk if we drop to 30 days compressed? See attachment 'Retention_TCO_AcmeOps.xlsx' for cost delta.
2) Lauren / Procurement — is sourcing via AWS Marketplace acceptable from a compliance/invoicing standpoint? If yes, we'll ask Anna to reissue quote as marketplace order.

Anna — if marketplace routing is possible, please outline any lead time or legal addendum required. Also flag if the Grafana Cloud addendum would need a separate PO. If it's helpful, I'll reach to Grafana partnership contacts and try to get a bundled term.

Thanks,
Sergio
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachment: Retention_TCO_AcmeOps.xlsx

From: markus_klein
To: sergio_alvarez, lauren_bishop
Cc: neha_kapoor
Date: 2026-06-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft renewal + retention add-on pricing

Sergio — quick technical read:

- 90-day indexed logs is nice for fast incident forensics but the bulk of our postmortem work can rely on 30-day indexed + 60-day archived (compressed) logs. That combo reduces query costs substantially.
- If AcmeOps' SLOs require 90-day interactive queries, we should keep it. Otherwise propose: 30d indexed + 60d compressed (cold storage) + on-demand rehydration SLA (24-48h)
- Grafana Cloud: if we bundle through marketplace we need to ensure data egress paths are covered in the contract (Grafana may host dashboards but logs stay in Datadog/Redwood). Ask Grafana legal to confirm.

I'll attach a brief tech note to the shared Drive and flagged a few risk items (query latency for rehydrated logs, restored retention costs).

-Markus
Director, Infra
markus.klein@redwood.com

Attachment: Grafana_marketplace_clause_draft.docx

From: lauren_bishop
To: sergio_alvarez, markus_klein, neha_kapoor
Cc: Anna Park <anna@datadog.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft renewal + retention add-on pricing

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps:

- Procurement ok with AWS Marketplace routing as long as Datadog supplies the marketplace quote and a marketplace line-item. Anna: can you reissue a marketplace-formatted quote and confirm whether the Grafana addendum is separate?
- Technical preference: prefer 30d indexed + 60d compressed with on-demand restore; Markus will write required SLA language and Neha will validate security controls for compressed storage.
- Action items:
  * Anna: marketplace quote + indication of legal addendum needs (due 2026-06-22)
  * Markus: draft SLA text for rehydration + note on egress (due 2026-06-21)
  * Neha: confirm compliance check for compressed retention (due 2026-06-21)
  * Sergio: coordinate Grafana outreach if marketplace bundling requires partner signoff (I can help loop in Procurement)

Let's schedule a 30-min alignment on Tuesday 2026-06-22 10:00 PT if Anna is available (invite to follow).

Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
